SYMPTOM: Release CI fails at notarization step with 403 error: 'A required agreement is missing or has expired'
CAUSE: Apple periodically updates agreements in the Developer Program; any pending agreement blocks notarization API calls
FIX: Sign into developer.apple.com/account, find and accept the updated agreement, then re-run the release CI job
PREVENT: If a release CI notarization step fails with 403, check Apple Developer agreements FIRST before investigating code issues — build and signing succeed, only notarization fails
